data.one_liner: SoundFont (.sf2) synthesizer plugin for Flutter to load soundfonts and play MIDI notes.
data.what_it_does: The flutter_midi_pro plugin allows you to load SoundFont (.sf2) files, change instruments, and play notes with MIDI commands. It supports expression features like pitch bend, aftertouch, master gain, and effects such as reverb and chorus.
use_when: You need to synthesize audio using SoundFont (.sf2) files in your Flutter app.
You want to play MIDI files or trigger individual notes and chords programmatically.
You need to build a virtual piano, synthesizer, or MIDI player.
avoid_when: You only need to play standard background audio tracks or simple sound effects without SoundFont synthesis.
strengths: Loads multiple SoundFonts at once and plays notes across 16 MIDI channels per soundfont.
Supports full expression surface including pitch bend, aftertouch, and control change messages.
Built-in effects support such as reverb and chorus.
weaknesses: Windows, Linux, and Web support are not currently documented as supported.
MIDI file playback features are currently Android-only.
data.setup_notes: Requires calling `init()` before using any methods. Android binaries are downloaded automatically on the first build.
